bite: Subject uses teeth to grip or cut the object.
carry: Subject holds and transports the object while moving.
clean: Subject removes dirt or marks from the object.
cut: Subject divides or penetrates the object using a sharp tool.
drive: Subject operates and controls a vehicle.
feed: Subject gives food to another person or animal.
get_off: Subject actively moves away from, releases, leaves behind, or abandons a stationary object (e.g., leaving a bag on the floor).
get_on: Subject mounts, enters, or positions themselves onto a vehicle or large object.
grab: Subject suddenly and firmly takes hold of the object.
hit: Subject strikes the object or person with physical force.
hold: Subject maintains the object firmly in their hands or grasp, without necessarily moving.
hug: Subject wraps arms tightly around another person.
kick: Subject strikes the object or person with their foot.
kiss: Subject touches another person with their lips.
knock: Subject strikes a surface to attract attention.
lean_on: Subject rests their body weight against an object or person.
lick: Subject passes their tongue over the object or person.
lift: Subject raises the object upward from a lower position.
play(instrument): Subject actively uses a musical instrument.
pull: Subject applies force to move the object toward themselves.
push: Subject applies force to move the object away from themselves.
ride: Subject sits on and travels via a vehicle or animal.
shake_hand_with: Subject and another person grasp hands in a greeting.
throw: Subject propels the object through the air by hand.
touch: Subject makes physical contact with an object or person without grasping it.
wave: Subject moves their hand back and forth as a signal.
